scope:
Explore TPU-style hardware on the retained, normal-inference RTL workload.

This consumes unchanged upstream programs, not a new workload schedule. Pilot
extrapolations select candidates only; a 100x result requires all 48 kernels
and subsequent modified-RTL numerical/cycle validation.

resources.matrix_write_service_scope: Aggregate bank service reserved at batch compute start; output-wave arbitration not validated.
resources.paired_dot_technology: DSP48E2 component verified; DSP58 mapping unverified
resources.scale_cache_prediction_scope: Canonical-order invalidation and intrinsic replacement pacing; asynchronous invalidations approximate
resources.vector_scratchpad_scope: Wide proposal requires this aggregate bank throughput and two independent read copies; bank/control mapping and write arbitration are unvalidated
resources.vector_pool_resource_scope: Result data and private input copies included; VPU pipeline state, DSP mapping, address/control and fanout need synthesis.
resources.two_macs_per_dsp_status: Hypothetical all-dot packing screen only; use explicit integer cell counts. Column ends and FP sites do not halve.
resources.scope: Explicit capacity/throughput assumptions; VPU, non-MXU DSPs, banking, routing and Fmax need implementation.

points.extrapolation_scope: Candidate selection only; intermediate attention positions not measured.
